name: Celestine ~Hikari to Kage to Uchuu Kaizoku~
original_name: セレスティン～光と影と宇宙海賊～
source:
One day a space pirate raids the Federal Government Base and kidnaps a young high official.
Will he escape from the pirate or change sides?

[From YaoiOtaku]
translation:
一天，一名宇宙海盗突袭联邦政府基地，绑架了一位年轻高官。
他会逃离海盗掌控，还是转而加入对方阵营？

[摘自YaoiOtaku]
